design_philosophy: Fusion over imitation. Premium, clean, high-contrast B2B and B2C marketplace. Content is king. Zoom in on influencer metrics. Use negative space aggressively to create an editorial, high-end feel rather than a typical cluttered SaaS.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-black text-slate-900
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold text-slate-900

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Use The 'Bento' Grid Protocol for the Influencer profile. Use The 'Control Room' Grid for the Brand Campaign dashboard.
spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: p-1, p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16. Use generous padding (p-8) for dashboard cards.

surface_styles.header: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-slate-200/50
surface_styles.cards_influencer: Neumorphic/Soft: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-6 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
surface_styles.cards_brand: Grid Borders: Sharp corners or minimal radius (rounded-md), bg-white border border-slate-200 p-6

components.strategy: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts. Use Shadcn components for interactive logic (Forms, Modals, Tables, Tabs). Heavily customize Shadcn to remove generic Vercel look.

buttons.primary: bg-indigo-950 text-white hover:bg-indigo-900 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all shadow-sm hover:shadow-md
buttons.secondary: bg-violet-100 text-violet-700 hover:bg-violet-200 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all
buttons.outline: border-2 border-slate-200 bg-transparent text-slate-900 hover:border-slate-300 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all

components.inputs: Shadcn Input/Select with h-12, rounded-lg, border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500 focus:border-transparent
components.tables: Shadcn Table with clean minimal borders, text-sm, text-slate-600. Headers text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500.

animations.list_stagger: Framer motion: initial opacity-0 y-4, animate opacity-1 y-0, stagger 0.1s
animations.micro_interactions: Active tabs slide indicator using framer-motion layoutId. Buttons slight scale down on tap (active:scale-95).

image_urls.description: Fashion influencer portrait, used for influencer profile mockup
Brand manager / modern office lifestyle portrait
Modern office table, used for campaign cover image

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA standards. Text over images must use gradient overlays (e.g., bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 to-transparent).

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Cabinet Grotesk and Satoshi via fontsource or Google Fonts (use similar alternatives like Outfit/Manrope if unavailable, but prefer custom).

Build the dashboard layouts. The Brand dashboard should feel like a 'Control Room' (dense, pure white/indigo, data-focused grids). The Influencer dashboard should feel like a 'Bento Grid' portfolio (soft edges, violet accents, visual heavy).
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the landing page hero section. Add subtle noise/grain texture overlay for a premium touch.
Implement Dual Auth logic using JWT/OAuth conceptually (mocked for MVP frontend).
Ensure the header uses glassmorphism (Crystal Glass rule: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with 1px border-b).
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, tabs).
Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', 'Open Sans', 'Lato' for headings.
Use Lucide-react for all icons, keeping strokeWidth consistent at 1.5.
DO NOT use placeholder URLs. Use the exact image_urls provided in this JSON.
Ensure all buttons have explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-indigo-900).
